name: Minowa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Minowa town emblem in white: a ring open at the upper fly with three diagonal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Minowa, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 25 October 1990; the emblem dates from 3 November 1959.

features.role: Minowa town emblem — a ring open at the upper fly with three diagonal bars
